title: STAND: Semantic Anchoring Constraint with Dual-Granularity Disambiguation for Remote Sensing Image Change Captioning
abstract: arXiv:2604.23309v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Remote sensing image change captioning (RSICC) aims to describe the difference between two remote sensing images. While recent methods have explored video modeling, they largely overlook the inherent ambiguities in viewpoint, scale, and prior knowledge, lacking effective constraints on the encoder. In this paper, we present STAND, a Semantic Anchoring Constraint with Dual-Granularity Disambiguation for RSICC, to progressively resolve these ambiguities. Specifically, to establish a reliable feature foundation, we first introduce an interpretable constraint to regularize temporal representations. Operating on these purified features, a dual-granularity disambiguation module resolves spatial uncertainties by coupling macro-level global context aggregation for viewpoint confusion with micro-level frequency-refocused attention for small-object scale enhancement. translated_abstract: 遥感图像变化描述（RSICC）旨在描述两幅遥感图像之间的差异。尽管近期方法探索了视频建模，但它们大多忽略了视角、尺度和先验知识中的固有模糊性，缺乏对编码器的有效约束。在本文中，我们提出了STAND，一种用于RSICC的双粒度消歧语义锚定约束方法，以逐步解决这些模糊性。具体而言，为了建立可靠的特征基础，我们首先引入一个可解释的约束来规范化时间表示。在这些净化后的特征上操作，一个双粒度消歧模块通过耦合宏观层面的全局上下文聚合以应对视角混淆，以及微观层面的频率重聚焦注意力以增强小目标尺度，从而解决空间不确定性。最终，为了将这些视觉消歧后的特征转化为预...
tldr: 本文提出STAND方法，通过语义锚定约束和双粒度消歧机制，有效解决遥感图像变化描述中的视角、尺度和先验知识模糊性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes STAND, which uses semantic anchoring constraints and dual-granularity disambiguation to effectively address ambiguities in viewpoint, scale, and prior knowledge for remote sensing image change captioning.
